module_summary: Lemmings with dig and splatter: a 7-state Moore FSM plus a saturating fall-duration counter decides walking, falling, digging or death.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Holds walk/fall/dig per direction plus DEAD; drives all four outputs.

anchors.name: fall_counter
anchors.why: Counts fall cycles saturating at 20; selects DEAD on landing after long fall.

anchors.name: dig
anchors.why: Dig command moves a walking lemming into DIGL/DIGR states.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Decoded from WL state; indicates walking left.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Decoded from WR state; indicates walking right.

groups.name: lemming_fsm
groups.description: Prioritized fall/dig/bump transitions per direction, with terminal DEAD state.

groups.name: fall_timer
groups.description: Counts cycles in falling states, cleared otherwise; feeds splatter decision.

groups.name: output_decode
groups.description: Moore decode of state into walk, aaah and digging outputs; all zero when DEAD.
